text: A frame shall reject arbitration ids outside the 11-bit (standard) or 29-bit (extended) range.
Signal encode followed by decode shall reproduce the physical value within one resolution step.
Receivers shall reject frames whose CRC or alive counter is invalid.
Charging shall be inhibited below 0 degC and above 45 degC.
Charge current shall taper linearly to zero between 80 % and 100 % SOC.
Any cell above 4.20 V shall raise an overvoltage fault.
Cruise control shall only engage between 30 and 180 km/h.
Pressing the brake shall cancel cruise control immediately.
Throttle output shall be zero unless cruise control is active.
With ABS the wheel shall not lock while vehicle speed is above 5 m/s.
ABS shall shorten the stopping distance compared with locked-wheel braking on the reference surface.
A DTC shall be confirmed only after N consecutive failed debounce cycles.
Unsupported diagnostic services shall be answered with negative response code 0x11.
The cluster shall display "--" when no valid speed frame arrived for 100 ms.
A tyre below 60 % of nominal pressure (normalised to 20 degC) shall be classified CRITICAL.
A pressure drop of 20 kPa or more within a 60 s window shall raise a rapid-loss alarm.
